name: Claude.ai
desc: Anthropic's assistant, with Projects, Artifacts and research
desc_zh: Anthropic 的对话助手，带 Project、Artifact 与研究模式
solves: A conversation does not carry over, so every answer restarts cold. Projects hold the context, instructions and files; Artifacts come back editable.
solves_zh: 对话之间不接上下文，每个回答都从冷启动开始。Project 存住上下文、说明和文件；Artifact 交回来还能改。
best_for: A document or dataset you have to actually work through, not look up.
best_for_zh: 当手头有一份材料要真读进去，而不是查一下就走。
